description: Agent Construction: submit a change order with the contract and the change log: the change order with its number, the contract it cites, its date, the change as described, currency, the price change (negative for a deduction), the time change in days, the previous and new contract totals and the new completion day as printed, and each approval with the party, role (owner, contractor, architect, engineer, lender or other) and day signed; the contract with its number, currency, original price, original completion day and the roles whose approval it requires; and optionally the change log with each entry’s id, number, description, price and time change, status (approved, pending, rejected or void) and date. The signed report gives the change order, the contract, the log entry and the approved changes before it, the previous total recomputed as the original price plus every approved change before this one, the new total as that plus this change, the new completion day recomputed in days, and the approvals required, signed and missing, and counts them, and names a divergent change order: another contract number, a previous or new contract total that does not add up, a log entry with another price or time change, a required approval missing, and a new completion day that does not add up; then a change order missing from the log, a log status other than approved beside printed approvals, another description and an approval dated before the change order, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No change log, no original price, no price change, or no required approvals leaves the change order unverified. Amounts compare to the cent. This reads a construction change order priced against the contract with its running total: wever_terms-change-check compares two versions of one set of terms section by section, wever_change-proof-check reads a coding agent’s change claim against its evidence, and wever_approval-version-check reads whether an approval still covers a changed document, while the change order check recomputes the contract total and completion day the change order prints. Verdict build_change_divergent, build_change_partial, build_change_unverified or build_change_consistent. POST /api/build-change-order-check. Reads the construction paperwork supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between documents only, with no structural, engineering or safety judgment, building-code compliance determination, valuation of work performed or legal advice on contracts, liens or permits, and the paperwork stays in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Construction reads supplied construction paperwork for consistency between documents: a building permit, a contractor license record, a bid, a construction contract, a change order, a lien waiver, a completion certificate or punch list record, and a payment application. Beside it, wever_workorder-create and the other wever_workorder tools and wever_agent-work-order-exchange are the action layer that creates, funds, delivers and releases work orders, while this family moves nothing and executes nothing and only reads paperwork; wever_agent-escrow-lite holds and releases escrowed funds, and escrow stays there; and the Agent Real Estate checks such as wever_realty-title-check read property records by parcel and address, not a project’s construction paperwork. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-construction-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-construction/.
